narrator: Dr. John Seward (diary), recounting Renfield's dying testimony and Mina's account
summary: Seward finds Renfield on the floor of his cell in a pool of blood with a broken back and a depressed skull fracture. Van Helsing trephines the skull above the ear, and Renfield briefly regains clarity. He confesses that the Count tempted him with flies, moths and a swarm of rats, that he invited the Count in, and that he then fought the Count bare-handed after realising Mrs. Harker was being drained. The Count threw him down and broke him. The party arms itself with crucifixes and Sacred Wafer, breaks down the Harkers' locked door and finds the Count forcing Mina to drink blood from his torn breast while Jonathan lies in a vampiric stupor. The Wafer and crucifixes drive the Count back and he dissolves into mist under the door. Downstairs the Count has burned Seward's manuscript and phonograph cylinders and killed Renfield; Quincey saw a bat fly west from Renfield's window. Mina tells her story at dawn: the Count's threat, the bite, and the forced blood drinking that binds her to his call.

scenes.title: Renfield found dying
scenes.summary: Seward finds Renfield on his left side in a glittering pool of blood, face bruised, back apparently broken, right arm and leg paralysed. The attendant cannot reconcile the face wounds with a broken back.
scenes.key_quote: he had received some terrible injuries; there seemed none of that unity of purpose between the parts of the body which marks even lethargic sanity.

scenes.title: Trephining
scenes.summary: Van Helsing sends the attendant away, diagnoses a depressed skull fracture over the motor area and trephines just above the ear while Arthur and Quincey wait on the bed.
scenes.key_quote: We shall operate just above the ear.

scenes.title: Renfield's confession
scenes.summary: Revived with brandy and water, Renfield tells how the Count came through the mist, showed him rats and promised lives for worship, how he let the Count in, and how he fought him on realising Mina was being drained.
scenes.key_quote: I must not deceive myself; it was no dream, but all a grim reality.

scenes.title: Arming and the corridor
scenes.summary: Everyone fetches the same kit used at Carfax. Van Helsing resolves to break the Harkers' door despite propriety.
scenes.key_quote: All chambers are alike to the doctor; and even were they not they are all as one to me to-night.

scenes.title: The Count in the Harkers' bedroom
scenes.time: Night, bright moonlight through yellow blind
scenes.summary: The door bursts open on the Count forcing Mina's mouth to his bleeding breast. Van Helsing holds up the Sacred Wafer, the others raise crucifixes, the Count cowers, a cloud covers the moon and he escapes as vapour under the door.
scenes.key_quote: The attitude of the two had a terrible resemblance to a child forcing a kitten’s nose into a saucer of milk to compel it to drink.

scenes.title: Aftermath in the bedroom
scenes.summary: Van Helsing wakes Jonathan with a wet towel; Mina calls herself unclean; Jonathan holds her; Van Helsing shields them with the golden crucifix.
scenes.key_quote: Unclean, unclean! I must touch him or kiss him no more.

scenes.title: Reports of the damage
scenes.summary: Arthur reports the study ransacked, manuscript burned, phonograph cylinders thrown on the fire and Renfield dead. Quincey saw a bat fly west from Renfield's window.
scenes.key_quote: I saw a bat rise from Renfield’s window, and flap westward.

scenes.title: Mina's testimony
scenes.summary: Mina recounts waking to find the Count in the mist, his threats against Jonathan, the bite, and being made to drink from his opened vein as punishment.
scenes.key_quote: When my brain says “Come!” to you, you shall cross land or sea to do my bidding

locations.name: Renfield's cell
locations.description: Padded patient's room in the asylum next to Carfax, with a bed and a sash window opening on the grounds; floor now bloodied.
features: sash window that opens an inch
corridor door guarded by an attendant
locations.quote: I found him lying on the floor on his left side in a glittering pool of blood.

locations.name: Seward's study
locations.description: Seward's study holds brandy decanter, carafe, the phonograph and the manuscript; ransacked by the Count with a fire burning papers and cylinders.
features: safe with the second copy of the manuscript
locations.quote: All the manuscript had been burned, and the blue flames were flickering amongst the white ashes

locations.name: The Harkers' bedroom
locations.description: Bedroom with a bed beside the window, a thick yellow blind and a gas lamp; the door locks from within.
locations.lighting_time: moonlight through yellow blind, later red dawn
locations.quote: The moonlight was so bright that through the thick yellow blind the room was light enough to see.

locations.name: Asylum grounds with yew tree
locations.description: Lawn with a belt of trees behind which Carfax and barking dogs lie, and a great yew where Quincey hides to watch.
locations.quote: I could see Quincey Morris run across the lawn and hide himself in the shadow of a great yew-tree.

characters.name: Renfield
characters.role: zoophagous patient, now dying, betrayed by the Count
characters.appearance: face horribly bruised, right side paralysed, skull depressed
characters.personality: lucid and remorseful in his last minutes, brave
notable_lines: I must not deceive myself; it was no dream, but all a grim reality.
abilities: madman's unnatural strength (failed against the Count)

characters.name: Count Dracula
characters.appearance: tall thin man in black, waxen face, aquiline white nose, red eyes, sharp white teeth, red scar on the forehead
characters.clothing: black, shirt torn open at breast
notable_lines: You may as well be quiet; it is not the first time, or the second, that your veins have appeased my thirst!
abilities: becomes mist and slips through cracks
controls flies, moths, rats and dogs
forces victims to drink his blood to bind them to his call

characters.name: Abraham Van Helsing
characters.appearance: older man in dressing gown and slippers at first
notable_lines: It may be there is a soul at stake!
We know the worst now. He is here, and we know his purpose.
abilities: wields Sacred Wafer and golden crucifix

characters.name: Arthur Holmwood, Lord Godalming
characters.personality: decent, reluctant to speak of Renfield's death before the Harkers
notable_lines: Things are moving too quickly and too strangely for sound sleep for any of us these times.

characters.name: Quincey Morris
notable_lines: He will not be back to-night; for the sky is reddening in the east, and the dawn is close. We must work to-morrow!

characters.name: Mina Harker
characters.appearance: white nightdress smeared with blood, throat wound, red grip marks on her hands

characters.name: Jonathan Harker
characters.appearance: face flushed in stupor, hair whitening by dawn
notable_lines: Guard her while I look for him!

characters.name: Simmons
notable_lines: I can’t understand the two things.

objects.name: Surgical case
objects.description: Van Helsing's case of surgical instruments for trephining.
objects.quote: Van Helsing returned with extraordinary celerity, bearing with him a surgical case.

objects.name: Brandy decanter and water carafe
objects.description: Decanter of brandy and carafe of water from Seward's study.
objects.function_in_story: Used to revive Renfield's lips so he can speak.
objects.quote: He flew and returned with a glass, the decanter of brandy and a carafe of water.

objects.name: Strait-waistcoat
objects.function_in_story: Renfield asks for it to be removed.
objects.quote: Tell them to take off the strait-waistcoat.

objects.name: Sacred Wafer in an envelope
objects.description: A consecrated Host carried in an envelope by Van Helsing.
objects.function_in_story: Held out at the Count, forcing him to stop and cower.
objects.quote: was holding towards him the envelope which contained the Sacred Wafer.

objects.name: Crucifixes
objects.description: Crucifixes carried by each party member.
objects.function_in_story: Raised together, drive the Count back.
objects.quote: Further and further back he cowered, as we, lifting our crucifixes, advanced.

objects.name: Golden crucifix (small)
objects.function_in_story: Held near Mina to protect her; no foul thing can approach it.
objects.quote: The Professor held up his little golden crucifix

objects.name: Matches and gaslight
objects.description: Quincey's match relights the gas in the Harkers' room.
objects.function_in_story: Reveals the vapour exiting under the door.
objects.quote: when the gaslight sprang up under Quincey’s match, we saw nothing but a faint vapour.

objects.name: Phonograph cylinders
objects.description: Wax cylinders carrying Seward's diary, thrown on the fire.
objects.function_in_story: Destroyed by the Count to cripple the party's records; a second copy is in the safe.
objects.quote: the cylinders of your phonograph too were thrown on the fire, and the wax had helped the flames.

objects.name: Manuscript copies
objects.description: Typed manuscript of all the diaries; one copy burned, a second in the safe.
objects.quote: Thank God there is the other copy in the safe!

objects.name: Sleeping draught
objects.description: Draught given to Mina by Van Helsing and Seward.
objects.function_in_story: Failed to protect her; Jonathan was in stupor anyway.
objects.quote: I took the sleeping draught which you had so kindly given me, but for a long time it did not act.

objects.name: Towel and cold water
objects.description: A towel dipped in cold water.
objects.function_in_story: Used to flick Jonathan's face and break the vampiric stupor.
objects.quote: He dipped the end of a towel in cold water and with it began to flick him on the face

objects.name: Sash window
objects.description: Window in Renfield's cell that opens an inch, through which the Count enters.
objects.function_in_story: Renfield's invitation lets the Count in.
objects.quote: though it was only open an inch wide

creatures.name: Rat swarm
creatures.description: Thousands of rats with blazing red eyes spreading over the grass like a flame of fire.
creatures.behaviour: Called and stopped by the Count's raised hand; used as a temptation.
weaknesses: dispersed when the Count wills it
creatures.quote: there were thousands of rats with their eyes blazing red—like His, only smaller.

creatures.name: Death's-head moth
creatures.description: Large moth with a skull and cross-bones on its back (Acherontia Atropos).
creatures.behaviour: Sent in by the Count as a gift to Renfield.
creatures.quote: big moths, in the night, with skull and cross-bones on their backs.

creatures.name: Steel-and-sapphire flies
creatures.description: Great fat flies with steel and sapphire wings.
creatures.behaviour: Sent in by the Count in daylight.
creatures.quote: Great big fat ones with steel and sapphire on their wings

creatures.name: Dogs of Carfax
creatures.description: Dogs barking beyond the trees behind the asylum.
creatures.behaviour: Bark and howl when the Count arrives.
creatures.quote: I heard the dogs bark behind our house, but not where He was!

creatures.name: Bat
creatures.description: Bat form of the Count flying west from Renfield's window.
creatures.quote: I saw a bat rise from Renfield’s window, and flap westward.

vampire_lore.rule: The vampire is stopped by the Sacred Wafer and crucifixes
vampire_lore.detail: The Count halts and cowers when the Wafer is held out and crucifixes raised together.
vampire_lore.quote: The Count suddenly stopped, just as poor Lucy had done outside the tomb, and cowered back.

vampire_lore.rule: The vampire can become mist and slide under or through gaps
vampire_lore.detail: He enters through a window open one inch and leaves as vapour under a door.
vampire_lore.quote: He slid into the room through the sash, though it was only open an inch wide

vampire_lore.rule: The vampire must be invited in
vampire_lore.detail: The Count begins to ask Renfield, who finally says 'Come in, Lord and Master!' and opens the window.
vampire_lore.quote: I found myself opening the sash and saying to Him: ‘Come in, Lord and Master!’

vampire_lore.detail: He sends flies, moths, rats and dogs and controls the mist.
vampire_lore.quote: He raised his hands, and seemed to call out without using any words.

vampire_lore.detail: Jonathan lies in a stupor the vampire can produce; cold water flicked on his face rouses him.
vampire_lore.quote: Jonathan is in a stupor such as we know the Vampire can produce.

vampire_lore.rule: The vampire's gaze overwhelms the strong
vampire_lore.detail: Renfield's strength turns to water when he meets the Count's eyes.
vampire_lore.quote: They burned into me, and my strength became like water.

vampire_lore.rule: Blood exchange binds the victim to the vampire's call
vampire_lore.detail: Count opens a vein on his breast and makes Mina drink so she must answer his mental summons across land and sea.
vampire_lore.quote: When my brain says “Come!” to you, you shall cross land or sea to do my bidding

vampire_lore.rule: The vampire's touch dulls the victim's will
vampire_lore.detail: Mina does not want to resist while he bites.
vampire_lore.quote: I did not want to hinder him. I suppose it is a part of the horrible curse

vampire_lore.detail: Quincey reasons he will not return that night because the east is reddening.
vampire_lore.quote: He will not be back to-night; for the sky is reddening in the east

vampire_lore.rule: The vampire has a changed smell and a drained victim shows paleness
vampire_lore.detail: Renfield notes the Count smelled different; Mina looked pale and bloodless the afternoon before.
vampire_lore.quote: I don’t care for the pale people; I like them with lots of blood in them, and hers had all seemed to have run out.

puzzles.name: Locked door of the Harkers' room
puzzles.setup: Mina and Jonathan are inside, the door is locked, the Count is within.
puzzles.book_solution: Van Helsing tries the handle, then all throw their shoulders against the door and burst it open.
puzzles.game_idea: Party-coordinated force-the-door timing minigame; each member adds strength before the Count's scene starts.
puzzles.quote: We threw ourselves against it; with a crash it burst open

puzzles.name: Where will the Count go
puzzles.setup: The Count vanishes as vapour at dawn.
puzzles.obstacle: Which lair does he flee to.
puzzles.book_solution: Quincey watches from the lawn and sees a bat rise from Renfield's window and fly west.
puzzles.game_idea: Stakeout puzzle: observe from hiding and read the direction of the flying bat to mark a lair on the map.
puzzles.quote: I expected to see him in some shape go back to Carfax; but he evidently sought some other lair.

puzzles.name: Timing the trephination
puzzles.setup: Renfield is dying; his words may be valuable.
puzzles.obstacle: Locate the spot, relieve pressure before he dies.
puzzles.book_solution: Van Helsing waits only long enough to fix the best spot, then trephines above the ear.
puzzles.game_idea: Surgery minigame: choose the incision spot on a head diagram before a timer runs out.
puzzles.quote: just long enough to fix the best spot for trephining, so that we may most quickly and perfectly remove the blood clot

puzzles.name: Rousing Jonathan from stupor
puzzles.setup: Jonathan is unconscious in a vampiric stupor.
puzzles.book_solution: Van Helsing flicks his face with a cold wet towel.
puzzles.game_idea: Use the right household item to break a status effect on a party member.

combat.name: Renfield versus the mist-Count
combat.tactics: Renfield grabbed the mist tight and held until the Count solidified; he lost when the Count's eyes drained his strength.
combat.outcome: Renfield thrown down and fatally injured; the Count slipped away.
combat.game_idea: Cutscene or tutorial defeat showing the Count's gaze attack and mist escape.
combat.quote: I saw the mist stealing in, and I grabbed it tight.

combat.name: Confrontation in the Harkers' bedroom
combat.tactics: Count springs at the party; Van Helsing holds out the Wafer, the others advance with crucifixes until the Count retreats and becomes vapour.
combat.outcome: Count driven off, Mina left bitten.
combat.game_idea: Boss encounter: he rushes the party, Wafer/crucifix stacking reduces his Menace until he flees as mist; party must protect Mina as a vulnerable ally with an HP bar.
combat.quote: The Count suddenly stopped, just as poor Lucy had done outside the tomb, and cowered back.
